channel.title: Plain Money Calculators: guides
channel.description: Plain-English money guides that work through real numbers, written by the author of the calculators.

item.title: How Much Should I Contribute to My 401(k)? 3% to 15% Compared
item.dc:creator: Kostan PROFF
item.description: What contributing 3%, 6%, 10% or 15% of pay to a 401(k) could grow to by 67, what it costs per paycheck, and how much starting age and returns change the result.

item.title: How Much House Can I Afford on My Salary? A 2026 Table
item.dc:creator: Kostan PROFF
item.description: The home price lenders' 28/36 rule allows at salaries from $40,000 to $200,000, and how debts, rates and the down payment move that number.

item.title: How Long Does It Take to Pay Off Credit Card Debt?
item.dc:creator: Kostan PROFF
item.description: Payoff times and total interest for $2,000 to $20,000 of card debt at 22% APR, paying the minimum or a fixed amount, plus what a balance transfer saves.

item.title: How Long Should a Car Loan Be? 36 to 84 Months Compared
item.dc:creator: Kostan PROFF
item.description: Monthly payment, total interest and how long you owe more than the car is worth on a $30,000 auto loan at 36, 48, 60, 72 and 84 months.

item.title: How to Choose an Online Mortgage Calculator
item.dc:creator: Kostan PROFF
item.description: What a good mortgage calculator should include, how simple and advanced tools differ, and the mistakes that make a payment estimate too low.
